legacy_beta48_r1_forensic_audit.control_flow_assessment: The archived wrapper family wrapped evaluator._install_h9_modules, which the repaired source documents as occurring before checkpoint restore. The checkpoint therefore overwrote the pruned weights. The profile and CSV were emitted, then the post-evaluation runtime/M300 mask-fraction check stopped the run before a receipt was written.
legacy_beta48_r1_forensic_audit.evidence_limit: Because r1 has no receipt or preserved stderr, the exact first failing FC1-versus-patch diagnostic is not recoverable; this strengthens, rather than relaxes, its exclusion.
legacy_beta48_r1_forensic_audit.prohibited_claim: The legacy r1 AEE equal to baseline is not a beta48 accuracy result and must never be cited.

repaired_runtime_identity.post_checkpoint_hook: h9_load_audit.load_checkpoint_with_h9_audit is wrapped; pruning is installed only after original_checkpoint_loader returns

performance_claim_audit.assessment: The 1.1841687x number remains an ideal cycle-weighted source-work sensitivity. The real S10 accuracy failure kills this candidate before executable-cycle or RTL work.

findings.title: The repaired group4/beta48 candidate fails the frozen accuracy gate by 5.53x
findings.evidence: Independent frame-equal recomputation gives delta AEE +0.1105312895066488 versus the allowed +0.02; even pixel-global weighting gives +0.1104476029116466.
findings.impact: The shared FC1 plus patch-Conv beta48 candidate is NO-GO. Valid825, executable-cycle adapter and RTL must not be started for promotion.
findings.required_action: Stop this candidate in accordance with M301. Do not relax the frozen AEE gate after observing the result.

findings.title: M300's 1.1841687x remains ideal sensitivity, not executable performance
findings.evidence: M300 explicitly leaves hardware_cycles, RTL, DC, power, system_speedup and headline false; it has no mask-fetch, routing, bank, scan, commit or SRAM schedule.
findings.impact: The accuracy failure cannot be traded against or hidden behind a claimed 1.184x speedup.
findings.required_action: Retain the sensitivity only as a rejected opportunity-study point, not as a paper performance result.

findings.title: Legacy beta48 r1 is invalid but is not self-tombstoned inside its directory
findings.evidence: It has no receipt, and its profile plus per-frame CSV are byte-identical to old beta0 r3 after a pre-checkpoint install path. The repaired run produces different metrics and stable post-mask hashes.
findings.impact: A reader who discovers only the legacy profile could incorrectly quote baseline AEE as beta48 accuracy. That would be a P0 claim error if cited.
findings.required_action: Use M305 as the exclusion record; never ingest an M301 result directory lacking the modified-forward receipt.

findings.title: The beta48 r2 top-level status string is not an explicit NO-GO
findings.evidence: The receipt says PASS_MODIFIED_FORWARD_REQUIRES_OR_FAILS_PAIRED_GATE while its paired accuracy_gate_pass and admission accuracy_gate_pass are false.
findings.impact: Automated consumers that inspect status only may misclassify a completed failure as a pass.
findings.required_action: Downstream registries must key on accuracy_gate_pass=false and the M305 NO-GO verdict, not the generic PASS prefix.

findings.title: S10 contains ten frames from one local validation sequence
findings.evidence: All ordered frames belong to zurich_city_09_a and the profile declares local_DSEC_valid_file_list_not_official_hidden_test.
findings.impact: The screen cannot characterize cross-sequence accuracy, although the large failure is sufficient for the prescribed early kill.
findings.required_action: Do not run valid825 for this killed candidate; require broader populations only for a future candidate that first passes its paired S10 gate.

next_action: Close shared group4/beta48 as NO-GO and do not spend promotion resources on beta32, valid825, cycle adaptation or RTL. Feed the failure back to algorithm work only if a new training-aware or separately gated FC1/patch mechanism is proposed under a new contract.
